    Prepending a letter to a half-word #

    cons l h prepends l to h. If h is valid at (l.tgt, !en l) and l starts at v with sign s, then cons l h is valid at (v, s), and its boundary subspaces are the transports of those of h along l (for an inverse letter and an infinite half-word this uses finite dimension).
